title: Restore Shiba companion bot on mobile and tablet viewports

acceptance.text: the companion bot renders at every viewport width (its root is not hidden below the lg breakpoint)
on screens below lg the mascot sits above the mobile bottom navigation bar (bottom offset covers the ~57px bar plus a gap and the safe-area inset) and stays tappable
on lg screens and up the mascot keeps its previous position (24px bottom offset plus safe-area inset, 20px right)
the chat panel and onboarding panel keep their viewport-safe widths on small screens
no behavior changes besides visibility and mascot placement

spec.expected_behavior: the companion bot renders at every viewport width; below lg the mascot floats above the mobile bottom navigation, on lg it keeps its previous 24px offset
spec.observed_behavior: since the UX-311 overhaul (2ed75948) the companion root carries 'hidden lg:block', so on viewports below 1024px the Shiba bot never renders and no other mobile entry point opens the companion chat
